programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: Official PGDM Program Fees page: admission confirmation 76,000 + tuition 7,80,000 + course material 80,000 + placement fee 32,000 + library & IT 32,000 + campus maintenance 1,00,000 = total programme fee Rs 11,00,000 (instalments Oct 2027, Jun 2028, Oct 2028). Plus refundable caution deposit Rs 30,000 (Rs 5,000 of it kept for alumni life membership) = Rs 11,30,000 day-scholar total; hostel Rs 60,000 x 4 = Rs 2,40,000 extra (Rs 13,70,000 with hostel). Fees subject to revision. Note: the page's FAQ still shows an older Oct 2026 - Oct 2027 instalment calendar for the same amounts.
programs.intakeNote: '2-year full-time program - Kolkata campus - 180 seats' (Batch 2027-29) on the official PGDM page.
programs.placementNote: Official Placements page, Final Placement Statistics Class of 2026: highest CTC 20.62 LPA, average 9.18 LPA, median 9.00 LPA, 94.63% placed, 64 companies, 23 new. Business Analytics segment: average 10.69 / median 11.57 LPA; HR/Operations: average 7.03 / median 7.10 LPA. The PGDM landing page shows different figures (highest 20.65, average 9.08 LPA) without a batch; the dated placements page is used. Audit not stated.

selectionProcess.name: Online application with entrance score
selectionProcess.detail: Valid score in CAT, XAT, CMAT, GMAT, MAT or ATMA; graduation with minimum 50% aggregate.

selectionProcess.name: Written Ability Test
selectionProcess.detail: Assessment of written communication; rolling basis, September 2026 - June 2027.

selectionProcess.name: Personal Interview and offer
selectionProcess.detail: Profile, aptitude, motivation and potential; merit-based final selection; no weights published.

keyDates.notes: PGDM 2027-29: rolling applications; WAT and PI on a rolling basis September 2026 - June 2027; course commences July 2027.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
